declarations.description: A payment card field, like Stripe Elements' card element: the card number, the expiry date and the security code in one box. The number is spaced as its brand prints it (Amex 4-6-5, most others 4-4-4-4), the brand shows as a badge, and focus moves on to the expiry once the number is complete and passes the Luhn check, then to the code. Backspace in an empty part goes back to the one before. Each part has its `autocomplete` token, so browsers and password managers fill it. The number never leaves the element unless the app asks: nothing is reflected to an attribute, and no event carries it. `card-change` reports the brand, whether the card is complete, the first problem and the last four digits; `getCardDetails()` returns everything for the payment provider's tokenize call. Under a `name` the form receives `name[number]`, `name[expiry]` (`YYYY-MM`) and `name[cvc]`, for an app that posts to its own PCI-scoped server. Problems show when a part loses focus, never while it is typed: an incomplete or invalid number, a brand outside `brands`, an invalid or past expiry date, an incomplete code. The form does not submit while there is one. It takes part in `c2-form-field`, which then shows the message. The badge is the brand's name in text: no trademarked logo is drawn. An app with licensed artwork puts it in the brand's slot (``).

members.name: brands
members.description: The brands accepted, by id (`visa`, `mastercard`, `amex`, `discover`, `diners`, `jcb`, `unionpay`, `maestro`). Empty accepts all. As an attribute, a `;`-separated list.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the form receives `name[number]`, `name[expiry]` and `name[cvc]`. With none, the card is not submitted.

members.name: required
members.description: Asks for a card before the form submits.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns the field off; as for a disabled form control, nothing is submitted.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Shows the card without letting it be edited.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the group. Inside a `c2-form-field`, the field's label names it.

members.name: touched
members.description: Parts that lost focus once: only their problems show.

members.name: brandAnnouncement
members.description: The detected brand's name, in a polite live region: announced once per change.

members.name: handlePageHide
members.description: A page kept in the back/forward cache must not keep the card: it is cleared as the page is stored.

members.name: brand
members.description: The brand detected from the digits typed so far, or `''`.

members.name: complete
members.description: Whether all three parts are filled in and valid.

members.name: getCardDetails
members.description: The card, for the payment provider's tokenize call. Read it on submit; do not keep it.

members.name: firstError
members.description: The first problem, by part: `{ segment, message }`, or `null`. With `all`, untouched parts count too.

members.name: editedDigits
members.description: Digits after an edit, with a deleted separator taking the digit before it with it.

members.name: caretAfter
members.description: The caret position after `count` digits in formatted text.
